title: Maximum Height By Stacking Cuboids
description: Find the maximum height of a stack of cuboids where a cuboid can be placed on top of another if its dimensions are strictly smaller in all categories after rotation.
pseudocode:
1. For each cuboid, sort dimensions so width <= depth <= height.
2. Sort all cuboids based on dimensions.
3. dp[i] = height[i] + max(dp[j] for all valid j < i).
4. Return max(dp).

steps.note: Calculate max height ending at index 0
Calculate max height ending at index 1 (can stack 0 on 1)
